name: Kobayashi (Japan, 1923–2006)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with the Kobayashi city emblem in blue: an outlined ring of concentric lines with four small bars, enclosing a small ring.
history: Earlier flag of Kobayashi city in Miyazaki Prefecture, used from 1923 to 2006.

features.role: Kobayashi city emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines with four small bars, enclosing a small ring
